column1: # Scan rules of legacy.md (tests/score): the rules of scan-rules.tsv used before the standards existed.
# Regexes must use the subset shared by POSIX ERE and .NET (no \b, \s, \d, lookaround). Fields are TAB-separated.
#   Defines a file scope: files whose path matches path-regex and that are in scope "within" (- = no condition,
#   !name = not in that scope). The built-in scope "any" covers every reviewed file. The summary of prepared.txt
#   counts the scopes named main, test and migration when they are defined.
#   PR-level hint: condition is a comma-separated list of has:<scope> (the PR adds lines to a file in the scope),
#   no:<scope> (the PR touches no file in the scope) and modified:<scope> (the PR modifies, deletes or renames an
#   existing file in the scope; the hint lists those files); all must hold.
# id  scope  flags  regex  prev-regex  exclude-regex  hint
#   Line rule. flags: i=case-insensitive  c=also match comment lines  -=none. prev-regex: the previous non-blank
#   new-side line must match (- = none). exclude-regex is matched against "previous line + current line".

column4: main code changed but the PR touches no test file (meets the C1 Critical condition if the change is business logic)

column7: Added/changed API endpoint: check B3 auth/ownership, B4 @Valid, G4 OpenAPI annotations
springdoc visible in diff, so G4 applies
@Transactional method throws without rollbackFor (check if checked exception)
catch starts with a log call; check whether the exception is swallowed
Date/Calendar or no explicit time zone
possible SQL/JPQL built by string concatenation
CSRF disabled; check for a comment or PR description reason
broad path pattern; check whether it is permitAll()
log may expose sensitive data or stack traces
CORS allows any origin; check whether credentials are allowed too
assertNotNull only? check for meaningful assertions
H2 in use; check for production-DB-specific SQL
test name does not state scenario and expectation
Controller imports an Entity; check if used as request/response
exception handled inside Controller; check @RestControllerAdvice + ProblemDetail
unpaged query; check whether the table keeps growing
